entities.summary: Herbert Henry Asquith, 1st Earl of Oxford and Asquith was a British statesman who was Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1908 to 1916. He was the last prime minister from the Liberal Party to command a majority government, and the most recent Liberal to have served as Leader of the Opposition.
